name: Efreeti Chain

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +3 AC, Immunity to Fire damage, you know Primordial, and you can walk on molten rock.
text: This armor gives you +3 to Armor Class, Immunity to Fire damage and knowledge of the Primordial language while you wear it. Molten rock also bears your weight, so you can stand and walk on it as easily as on firm ground.
